# Licences for the outside code in vendor/

The files in vendor/ are built by tools/vendor-editor/build.mjs from the packages below.

vendor/prosemirror.js and vendor/prosemirror.css (all MIT):

- prosemirror-model 1.25.13
- prosemirror-state 1.4.4
- prosemirror-view 1.42.9
- prosemirror-transform 1.12.5
- prosemirror-commands 1.7.2
- prosemirror-keymap 1.2.3
- prosemirror-history 1.5.1
- prosemirror-inputrules 1.6.0
- prosemirror-schema-list 1.6.0
- prosemirror-dropcursor 1.8.4
- prosemirror-gapcursor 1.4.1
- prosemirror-tables 1.8.5
- orderedmap 2.1.1
- rope-sequence 1.3.4
- w3c-keyname 2.2.8

vendor/markdown-it.js:

- markdown-it 15.0.3 (MIT)
- entities 8.1.0 (BSD-2-Clause)
- linkify-it 6.1.0 (MIT)
- mdurl 2.1.0 (MIT)
- punycode.js 2.3.1 (MIT)
- uc.micro 3.0.0 (MIT)


vendor/mammoth.js (opening Word files):

- mammoth 1.13.0 (BSD-2-Clause). Its ready-made browser build, used as it is, also holds the packages it depends on, each under the MIT or a BSD licence: among them jszip (MIT, its authors' choice of two), bluebird, underscore, xmlbuilder, lop, option, dingbat-to-unicode, base64-js, sax and path-is-absolute.

vendor/docx.js (saving Word files):

- docx 9.15.3 (MIT), with what it depends on: jszip (MIT), xml-js, sax, hash.js, inherits, minimalistic-assert and nanoid (all MIT or ISC).
